reviews.review_description: I've played this game for about 45 mins and I've had alot of fun with it, however the hand tracking inputs dont work sometimes ruining the scores (but luckily it does have controller support) second the game just needs to be a bit more clear  in the tutorials as I barely understood it. And 3rd the game just needs more polish and base game content. But even with all of these issues the game has great potential and im excited to see what's in store

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for supporting AiRhythm! I’m a solo developer building it, so licensing songs is mostly off the table. However - I am still working behind the scenes to push out more base-game content by composing and charting the songs myself (and also some help from artists that want their songs in for free, which they’re always cool). Satellite (our community chart platform) is also always an option.

Once again - thank you so much for supporting AiRhythm!
- Hat,
Founder @ CreativeCrew.games
